# tracker — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Address tracker: REST activities for KOL / smart money / custom address activity. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl tracker <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### tracker activities
Get latest DEX activities for tracked addresses (smart money, KOL, or custom multi-address)
`ocl tracker activities --tracker-type <TRACKER_TYPE> [options]`
- `--wallet-address <WALLET_ADDRESS>` — Wallet addresses (required for multi_address), comma-separated, max 20
- `--trade-type <TRADE_TYPE>` — Trade type: 0=all (default), 1=buy, 2=sell
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain filter (e.g. ethereum, solana)
- `--min-volume <MIN_VOLUME>` — Minimum trade volume (USD)
- `--max-volume <MAX_VOLUME>` — Maximum trade volume (USD)
- `--min-holders <MIN_HOLDERS>` — Minimum number of holding addresses
- `--min-market-cap <MIN_MARKET_CAP>` — Minimum market cap (USD)
- `--max-market-cap <MAX_MARKET_CAP>` — Maximum market cap (USD)
- `--min-liquidity <MIN_LIQUIDITY>` — Minimum liquidity (USD)
- `--max-liquidity <MAX_LIQUIDITY>` — Maximum liquidity (USD)
